operation.summary: Link a source. This build links the sandbox instrument only: a sandbox key is made at the sandbox provider and stored on this device, write-only. It needs no namespace: the instrument fixes it; explicit owner.configuration grant required

body.name: id
body.description: A name for the source, 1 to 64 of a-z 0-9 . _ -; made up when left out

operation.returns: the source as in the list; conflict when the id is taken or was linked before (reason id_retired)

idempotency_key.description: Any UUID; repeating the call with the same key within 24 h returns the first result instead of acting twice

id.description: A name for the source, 1 to 64 of a-z 0-9 . _ -; made up when left out
